title: Sign up and create an OTA
summary: A new owner signs up on the [[app:portal]], verifies the e-mail and creates an OTA ([[tenant]]).
prerequisites: The platform API and the portal run locally ([[page:getting-started]]).

steps.title: Open the sign-up page
steps.actions: Open the page. Fill in **Full name**, **E-mail** and a 12-character password.
steps.expect: The form validates as you type; a short password shows an inline error.

steps.title: Create the account
steps.data:
```sql
SELECT email, status FROM platform.accounts ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
```
Expect `pending_verification`.

steps.title: Verify the e-mail
steps.actions: Open the newest e-mail in Mailpit and click the link.
steps.expect: The portal shows **E-mail verified**; `email_verified_at` is set.

steps.title: Create an OTA
steps.actions: Sign in, open **New OTA**, enter a name and the key `demo`.
steps.expect: The OTA appears with status **provisioning**, then **active** ([[provisioning]]).
steps.data: `platform.tenants` has a row with `schema_name = 'tenant_demo'`; `platform.tenant_memberships` has the founder as `owner`.

steps.title: Try a reserved key
steps.actions: Create another OTA with the key `platform`.
steps.expect: The form rejects the key with a clear message; no row is written.
